title: Rajbhasha Utkrishtta Sammaan to Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances in the category of Ministries/Departments with less than 300 personnel for the year 2025-26, by the Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs
body_text:
The Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances, New Delhi, has been selected for "Rajbhasha Utkrishtta Sammaan" for the year 2025–26 by the Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, for its outstanding work and continuous excellent performance in the implementation of the Official Language.
It is noteworthy that the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances was honored with the Rajbhasha Kirti Puraskar (First) by the Department of Official Language for two consecutive years—2023–24 and 2024–25.
This year as well, the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances, New Delhi, secured the first position for its excellent performance in the implementation of the Official Language.
According to the rules, if a Ministry/Department receives the first prize for two consecutive years, it is not awarded the Puruskar in the subsequent year.
However, the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances has been consistently performing outstanding work in the field of the Official Language for several years. Therefore, to recognize its continuous excellence in the implementation of the official language, the Department has been selected for this special "Rajbhasha Utkrishtta Sammaan."
This "Rajbhasha Utkrishtta Sammaan" will be presented to the Department during the Hindi Diwas Sammelan scheduled to be held in Navi Mumbai on September 14, 2026, on the occasion of Hindi Diwas.
***
NKR/Anand
